description: HEAVY: Runs REAL inference. Measures a model on this machine with a warmup (absorbs load time) plus N streamed runs: time-to-first-token, generation tokens/sec (runtime-reported when available, else measured after the first token), and prompt-processing speed. Pass models[] to compare several models with the same prompt, ranked by generation speed.

models.description: Compare several models (ranked by median generation tokens/sec)

provider.description: Provider instance name. Omit to let the server choose (local providers only, unless LOCAL_AI_ALLOW_HOSTED_FALLBACK is set).

warmup.description: Run a 1-token warmup first so load time is excluded (default true)

name: benchmark
title: Benchmark
